A 4xx or 5xx response still confirms the request reached the API. If an APK action adds no row, check its API URL, network access and hosting route. Requests from all clients are included; this feed cannot identify a particular phone.

How to read this page

  • API process passes, database fails: check the database configuration and migrations.
  • HTML, a hosting 404 or a Node welcome page at an API URL: the domain is not serving the Nest API at that route.
  • Successful test request, but no row for an app action: compare the APK’s base URL with the API base URL above.

No passwords, tokens, request bodies, user identifiers, query strings or IP addresses are shown. Counts reset on restart and belong to one process. Multiple workers have separate feeds; this is a temporary connectivity aid, not a persistent access log.

Instance information will appear when connected.
